notes.title: Version 6.001 - 6.006
notes.notes:
Version 6.001 
+ Fixed a crash occurring on visibility computation performed on old cpus

Version 6.002
+ Fixed a problem with camera control point selection, when control points 3d coordinates are imported first
+ Fixed a problem that prevented enhance filter to be computed correctly
+ Fixed a problem with camera calibration and certain types of dji drones
+ Stability improvements
+ Minor fixes

Version 6.003
+ Fixed an issue with advanced settings on dense point cloud generation
+ Fixed a problem with initial orthophoto resolution
+ Fixed an issue when saving files with Unicode characters
+ Fixed a problem with old project loading in Scarlet
+ Stability improvements
+ Minor fixes

Version 6.003
+ Fixed an issue with advanced settings on dense point cloud generation
+ Fixed a problem with initial orthophoto resolution
+ Fixed an issue when saving files with Unicode characters
+ Fixed a problem with old project loading in Scarlet
+ Stability improvements
+ Minor fixes

Version 6.004
+ Fixed a crash that occurred sometimes when deleting a selected shape in free drawing
+ Fixed a crash occurring on Ground Selection Filter
+ Fixed a problem with alembic (abc) import
+ Added corner picking in Scarlet
+ Fixed an issue with duplicated names on some filesystems
+ Samantha Deep preset rebalanced
+ Minor fixes

Version 6.005
+ Added numeric editing for plane dimensions in tools that use a plane (selection, cut, etc...)
+ Added png 16 bit export format for textures and normal maps
+ Sfm minor tweaks
+ Added csv export option for 3d control points coordinates 
+ Fixed a crash related to calibrations when adding new photos to the workspace 
+ Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred when using masks
+ Fixed a bug in ncn format export (control points)
+ Fixed a minor bug related to the photoconsistency filter when checking the "enhance only" option 
+ Fixed a crash occurring when you select no checkpoints on align with control points dialog
+ Changed policy to show points with track length < 3 (added option to rollback)
+ Improved 3DK importing speed 
+ Set Zephyr as default model viewer is now unchecked by default (except for Zephyr Free)
+ Autosave will now work even if windows update decide to kill the machine (solved a hard to replicate issue from version 1.0 :) )
+ Added scan renaming (Scarlet)
+ Importing scan names with e57 and RCP format (Scarlet)
+ Improved automatic camera placement with gizmo (Scarlet)
+ Minor fixes

Version 6.006
+ Fixed a crash occurring during Stereo on failure
+ Fixed a problem with maximum bounding box limits
+ Fixed a degenerate case occurring on mesh subdivider
+ Fixed bounding box calculation when importing unreconstructed data 
+ Fixed a crash occurring when the volume of interest did not contain any mesh triangle 
+ Fixed a bug when generating planar textures with geo-referenced datasets 
+ Zephyr might now start on a fully updated Windows 7 (please remember that Windows 7 is not officially supported by neither Microsoft or 3Dflow and declared EOL on January 2020)
+ Minor fixes

notes.title: Happy Pi Day! Enjoy the release of Zephyr 3.141!
notes.notes:
Happy Pi Day!

To celebrate, we have released 3DF Zephyr 3.141! *

+ Added hardware monitor window
+ Fixed a bug in sketchfab export
+ Fixed a bug in remeshing with no cameras loaded in export
+ Fixed a bug that would crash zephyr when renaming certain textured meshes
+ Fixed a Qt related memory issue in the log panel
+ Tiff file loading speedup (can be disabled in application options)
+ Minor UI fixes

* there has been an internal debate, whether should we use an additional decimal or the round up approximation. We went for the additional decimal value.
